_comment: Source of truth for GitHub milestones and labels. Synced by .github/workflows/tracker-sync.yml (scripts/tracker/sync.py). Order = roadmap order (docs/planning/08). Edit here, never only in the GitHub UI.

milestones.title: M0 — Foundations
milestones.description: Repo, CI gates, local dev, Money library, errors/logging, synthetic data, Terraform skeleton. Brief: docs/planning/13-milestone-0-brief.md.

milestones.title: M1 — Secure tenancy + core ledger
milestones.description: OIDC+MFA, workspaces, RLS, roles, audit log, chart of accounts, periods, journal entries, corrections, TB/GL, integrity, UI, docs. Brief: docs/planning/14; acceptance: docs/planning/09; report: docs/milestone-1-report.md.

milestones.title: M2 — Registers, banking, basic reporting
milestones.description: Cloud packaging, dimensions, counterparties + open items, VAT codes, documents, bank import + reconciliation, taxonomy, reporting.actuals, statements, year-end. Brief: docs/planning/15-milestone-2-brief.md.

milestones.title: M3 — Calculation framework + 13-week cash forecast
milestones.description: Calendar, metrics core, expression evaluator, obligations and debt, tax calendar, payment behaviour, 13-week cash forecast, what-ifs, cash dashboard.

milestones.title: M4 — Budgets, KPIs, goals, CFO dashboard v1
milestones.description: Budgets with versions and approvals, BvA, KPI library, custom KPIs, goals and goal-seek, alerts, CFO dashboard v1, firm portfolio dashboard.

milestones.title: M5 — Personal MVP + pilot readiness (Gate P)
milestones.description: Personal workspace UX, personal budgets and goals, engagements, pilot environment IaC (applied only with owner approval), data export and deletion. Ends at Gate P: owner-only pilot with your own data.

milestones.title: M6 — Three-statement projections + rolling forecasts
milestones.description: Fixed assets + depreciation, driver/assumption sets, integrated 3-statement projection engine, rolling 12/24-month forecasts, FX (moved from M2-10).

milestones.title: M7 — Scenarios, sensitivity, working capital
milestones.description: Scenario modelling, sensitivity/tornado, working-capital forecasting, goals vs scenarios, advanced KPIs.

milestones.title: M8 — Management reporting + dashboard v2 (Gate G)
milestones.description: Report packs, dashboard v2, email alerts. Ends at Gate G: pen-test, ASVS L2, DPA, consumer terms, DR drill — required before external customers.

milestones.title: M9 — Rules engine + Cyprus VAT
milestones.description: Rules engine with curated, versioned packs; CY.VAT with official examples; VAT return preparation and sign-off (never auto-submitted). Needs a verified Cyprus tax professional.

milestones.title: M10 — Corporate income tax, SDC, IFRS statements
milestones.description: CY.CIT, CY.SDC, IR4 preparation data, IFRS statements with notes scaffolding.

milestones.title: M11 — Audit module + regulatory monitoring
milestones.description: Audit engagements (materiality, working papers, PBC, sampling, sign-offs), regulatory change monitoring, evidence pack v2. No automated audit opinions.

milestones.title: M12 — AI gateway + AI CFO (read-only)
milestones.description: Separately deployed AI gateway, data-class policy, read-only tools, numeric-provenance validator, AI panel, red-team suite. The LLM never calculates or posts.

milestones.title: M13 — Source-linked regulatory explanations
milestones.description: Explanations over the verified source library, uncertainty flagging, professional-review routing.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: A backlog item that adds product capability

labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: A milestone-level item to be split into issues when its milestone starts

labels.name: type:decision
labels.description: A decision only the product owner can make

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Something does not work as specified

labels.name: status:in-review
labels.description: Implemented; PR open and waiting for product owner review

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed; the issue says on what

labels.name: needs:owner
labels.description: Waiting for an answer or approval from the product owner

labels.name: area:security
labels.description: Touches authentication, authorization, isolation or secrets

labels.name: area:infra
labels.description: Deployment, CI, IaC (never applied without approval)
